title: Create an OTA and watch provisioning
caption: createTenant → provision job → OTA worker → post-steps → active. Needs the OTA worker running.

steps.title: Check the key
steps.expect: `available: true` for a free key matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9]{2,29}$` and not reserved.

steps.title: Create
steps.body: `POST /v1/tenants` with `Idempotency-Key` (16-128 chars) and `{key, name, countryCode, defaultCurrency, timeZone}`.
steps.expect: `202 {tenant, provisioningJob, checkoutUrl: null}`; rows in tenants, tenant_memberships, subscriptions, tenant_domains, provisioning_jobs, platform_audit_log. Same key and body again replays the stored 202.

steps.title: Reveal the initial keys once
steps.expect: `pk_test_…` and `sk_test_…` once; a second call answers `410`; `provisioning_jobs.revealed_at` set; unrevealed ciphertext erased after 24 h by `provisioning.purge_reveals`.

steps.title: Check e-mail and data
steps.body: Mailpit: `tenant.welcome`. psql: `select status, schema_name from platform.tenants where key='acme';`
steps.expect: `active`, `tenant_acme`; an assigned office in `platform.amadeus_offices`; a `velexis` test payment connection.
